content: Speech that causes no agitation, that is truthful, pleasing, and beneficial is the true penance of the tongue.
author: Sanskrit Subhashitas
sourceWork: Anudvega-karam vakyam (अनुद्वेगकरं वाक्यं सत्यं प्रियहितं च यत्) — Bhagavad Gita XVII.15
explanation: You do not need to retreat to a cave in the Himalayas to practice spiritual discipline (Tapas). Simply discipline your tongue so that your speech never stirs up needless anxiety, speaks rigorous truth, and brings practical benefit to those who hear it.
practicalInsight: Before uttering any remark today, verify all four tests: Does it cause no agitation? Is it true? Is it pleasing? Is it beneficial?
reflectionPrompt: How much of your daily communication would be eliminated if you filtered out all speech that stirs up needless agitation?
